S7 (387,366) -> JUNCTION: the 30k resistor's top lead runs up and dead-ends on the top rail; the rail continues left and right. No hop, no crossing branch to pass through.
S8 (625,388) -> JUNCTION: the 16uH inductor's top lead dead-ends on the top rail, same geometry.
S12 (393,562) -> JUNCTION: the 30k resistor's bottom lead dead-ends on the bottom rail.

The remaining sites (S0,S1,S2,S4,S5 on the '17uH' caption over the inductor, S9 on the '30 k' caption beside the resistor) are handwriting strokes brushing component ink; left at default, they touch no terminal.
